blocks.text: The Constitution establishes the institutions of government, distributes public powers, and sets limits that protect rights. Its framework combines a strong Union with elected governments at the Union and State levels.

items: A written and detailed constitutional document.
A federal system with a strong Union.
An independent judiciary with power to review laws.
A universal adult franchise for elections.

blocks.caption: The Constitution provides for government at Union, State, and local levels.

blocks.title: Study connection
blocks.text: Link each feature to the part of the Constitution that explains it—for example, rights to Part III and Directive Principles to Part IV.
